column2: Commission a Runestone

Commission a runestone to chronicle your deeds or the memory of a dead parent. A Norscan stone is raised on a hill for all to see, a dawi stone is cut into the ancestor hall of the hold. This can be done only once in a lifetime.
You will raise a runestone in honor of your own person.
The carvers set to work cutting and painting the runestone.
The grudge will be cut into stone for all to read. Your rival will lose §Y50§! prestige and hate you for it.
The runestone you commissioned has been finished and raised on the hill you chose for it, where every sail on the fjord can see it. You examine the runes:
The runesmiths have finished their work, and the stone stands in the ancestor hall of the hold among the stones of your forebears. You run a hand over the deep-cut Khazalid runes:
You leave the stone, content in the knowledge that long after its paint has faded and the gods have taken you, men will still stand before it and read your name.
You leave the hall, content in the knowledge that long after you have gone to the Halls of the Ancestors your descendants will read these runes and remember. Stone does not forget.

You have decided to commission a great runestone for the generations to come. What should be carved into it?
Let it speak of me.
It shall stand in memory of [Root.Father.GetTitledFirstName], my departed father.
It shall stand in memory of [Root.Mother.GetTitledFirstName], my beloved mother.
The carvers who will cut and paint the runestone are asking for instructions. Which of your qualities should it speak of?
Oh, I don't know. Make something up.
I know exactly what the stone should say...
It schall shpeak of mead, schpirits, *hic* and other ssusch wondersch.
It must share my beauty with the world.
Let it show what a giant I was despite my stature.
My wisdom must be preserved.
Uhm... you decide...
The runes must say that I had the strength of ten men!
My great knowledge of the world.
I care not what you write, but it must show my impaled enemies!
It should speak of summer fields, moonlit nights and...
Just carve in my image and make sure it is well-endowed.
Carve in all of my favorite recipes.
Let it speak of sharing.
It should mention the importance of being kind to others.
You will mention my greatness, the epic deeds I have performed and the...
Oh, there is not much to say...
It will say that I feared nothing.
I wish to be known for my fairness in all things.
My strong bonds to the gods of my forefathers.
My devotion to [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName].
My harsh but necessary actions.
The demon within me must be heard.
The coasts I burned and the gold I carried home.
Cut the grudge against [runestone_grudge_target.GetTitledFirstName] into it, so that no one forgets.
In Memory of [runestone_parent.GetFirstName]
The Stone is Raised
It's perfect!

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], had this stone raised in [Root.GetHerHis] own memory while [Root.GetSheHe] lived. May [Root.GetSheHe] be remembered with joy and happiness.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], proud [Root.GetSonDaughter] of a holy union between [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], a wild mare and three forest spirits, paid Olaf handsomely to carve these runes. With [Root.GetHerHis] flying longship and its crew of twelve singing rabbits, [Root.GetFirstName] earned [Root.GetHerHis] fame by sailing across the Northern Wastes solving crime. May the Shining Tentacle preserve us all.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], had this stone raised in memory of [Root.GetHerselfHimself] in [Root.GetHerHis] own lifetime. Let it be said that [Root.GetHerHis] love for mead and spirits was second to none.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], ordered this stone raised during [Root.GetHerHis] own lifetime. It is true that [Root.GetHerHis] beauty and fair features were without equal in all the lands of the north. Alfr carved, Einarr painted.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], had this stone carved in [Root.GetHerHis] own memory. Though [Root.GetSheHe] was slight of size, [Root.GetFirstName] had the will of a giant. Oddr carved this memorial while [Root.GetSheHe] lived.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

This stone was raised by [Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], to celebrate [Root.GetHerHis] great wisdom. Truly no greater thinker lived in this age, or the ones before. Toke carved these runes.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName] the Hapless, [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], somehow managed to see this stone raised in [Root.GetHerHis] own memory. Many said [Root.GetSheHe] was worthless and would amount to nothing, and perhaps they were right. The great Tjudmund, whose skill with women was legendary, took pity and carved these words.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], commanded that this stone be raised in [Root.GetHerHis] lifetime. It was said that [Root.GetSheHe] had the strength of ten men, and no one dared oppose this claim. The stone was carved by Orm.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName] the Learned, [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], asked for this stone to be raised in [Root.GetHerHis] name. The knowledge [Root.GetSheHe] held of the world and all of its wonders was the envy of all. Hrolfr carved these words.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], had this stone raised and painted with the blood of [Root.GetHerHis] enemies while [Root.GetSheHe] still lived. Those foolish enough to go against [Root.GetFirstName] met their end impaled on a pole. Egil carved these runes before he suffered this very fate.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

This stone was raised by [Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], to celebrate the beauty of the world. Like a shining rainbow or the glittering sea, [Root.GetFirstName] brought joy and light into the lives of those who met [Root.GetHerHim]. Asbjorn reluctantly carved these words.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], likely parent of countless bastards, had this stone raised in memory of [Root.GetHerselfHimself]. Let no one deny the love [Root.GetSheHe] felt for others. Anund carved, Gorm painted.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], raised this stone in [Root.GetHerHis] own lifetime. Like no one before [Root.GetHerHim], [Root.GetFirstName] could appreciate a good meal. Here is the recipe for roasted boar the way [Root.GetSheHe] prefers it...

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], had this stone raised with the help of Sigtrygg. Throughout the land, [Root.GetFirstName] was known for [Root.GetHerHis] great charity to others. No wanderer seeking food or shelter at one of [Root.GetHerHis] holdings was turned away.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

This stone was raised by [Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], who was renowned for [Root.GetHerHis] great kindness to all things living. May [Root.GetSheHe] be treated by all others, now and in the afterlife, in that same manner.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName] the Great, [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], raised this stone to honor the legacy of [Root.GetHerHis] famous deeds. In all the world, no one was [Root.GetHerHis] equal.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

The words on this stone belong to [Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], but the carving was done by Tyke and Ragnvald painted. Let it be known that [Root.GetFirstName] lived a simple life without distractions, grateful for the company and friendship those around [Root.GetHerHim] provided.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

While [Root.GetSheHe] still lived, [Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], had this stone raised in [Root.GetHerHis] own memory. Even [Root.GetHerHis] enemies cannot deny the great courage of [Root.GetFirstName]. Those who knew [Root.GetHerHim] swear that when faced with danger, [Root.GetSheHe] was always without fear.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], had this stone raised in [Root.GetHerHis] own lifetime. There was no one more fair and just in all things. Men and women travelled far to seek [Root.GetHerHis] counsel in disputes. Kolbjorn carved these runes.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], ordered this stone raised in honor of the gods. No one was more devoted to [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], and no one more deserving of a seat at [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]'s side when the long night comes. These runes were carved by Grim and painted by Borkvard.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], ordered this stone raised in the everlasting glory of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]. May [Root.GetSheHe] be granted eternal might. These runes were carved by Thorolf and painted by Balder.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], had these runes carved in [Root.GetHerHis] own lifetime. No one was more feared than [Root.GetFirstName] in the realm of men, and [Root.GetHerHis] enemies suffered the pains of a thousand deaths for daring to oppose [Root.GetHerHim].

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], the mortal vessel of Malal, One True God of the Realm of Chaos, had these runes carved to celebrate the immense power of [Root.GetHerHis] master. Quake in fear, pitiful mortals. A thousand years from now a great darkness shall descend upon the world, consuming all those unworthy and chaining the rest into eternal slavery in service of Lord Malal.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], had this stone raised while [Root.GetSheHe] still lived. [Root.GetSheHe] sailed south with the dragon-ships and burned the halls of the southlings from Marienburg to the coasts of Bretonnia. Much gold [Root.GetSheHe] carried home, and many thralls. Ulf carved, Steinar painted.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]

[Root.GetRunestoneOpening]

[Root.GetFirstName], [Root.GetRunestoneLineage], had this stone cut so that no dawi shall ever forget the wrong done by [runestone_grudge_target.GetTitledFirstName]. Let the grudge stand in stone until it is struck from the Book in blood. Thorgrim Runecutter set these runes.

[Root.GetRunestoneClosing]
